metadata.description: Per (concept, t) unit: input = frozen feature vector (JSON, features at <= t); output = network-only emergence E(c,t) under PRIMARY volume; predict_baseline_A = P(E) from frequency/burst + degree/centrality-growth logistic model; predict_method_B = P(E) from A + 3 pre-named precursors (accretion share, closure over Chung-Lu null, participation rise). Rolling-origin predictions where the origin was usable, grouped-CV (labelled secondary) otherwise.
